source: synthetic_targeted_events_800_v1.csv candidate pool; never human gold

productAudit.mode: fully automatic programmatic audit and deterministic minimal repair; no sample-by-sample human review
productAudit.repairPriority: remove known transition/explanatory tails while preserving the core Event; add concrete personal relationship context only for role-led third-person reports; replace only if deterministic repair cannot produce a valid Event
productAudit.automaticRemoval: invalid 20-300 character Event shape, exact/normalized duplicate after repair, or TF-IDF char>=0.90 / word>=0.85 near-duplicate pair; lower rowId wins
productAudit.forbidden: emotion-label injection, target-label leakage, RTN/COSO/incumbent-guided repair, mechanical I-saw/I-heard wrappers

blindAgents.independence: Each receives only rowId, final Event text, fixed Product-18 definitions, and 0-2 output contract. Other agents, generator targets, source generator, incumbent, COSO, RTN, consensus, and desired counts are hidden. All three outputs freeze before deterministic consensus.

consensusPolicy.high: all three exact label sets match
consensusPolicy.medium: exactly two exact label sets match
consensusPolicy.unresolved: no exact two-of-three label-set agreement; exclude
consensusPolicy.uncertainty: diagnostic only and never overrides exact-set agreement

trainingDecision.highOnlyGate: HIGH rows>=300, HIGH non-empty>=200, >=10 represented labels, >=8 labels with support>=5, max label share<=0.35, empty rate<=0.50
trainingDecision.resolvedGate: HIGH+MEDIUM rows>=500, non-empty>=250, >=12 represented labels, >=10 labels with support>=5, max label share<=0.35, empty rate<=0.50, and >=15 two-label rows
trainingDecision.selection: Use HIGH only if its gate passes; otherwise use HIGH+MEDIUM if the resolved gate passes; otherwise DO_NOT_TRAIN. Never use UNRESOLVED.
trainingDecision.emptyRows: Within the selected consensus tier, keep all non-empty rows and the first rowIds needed to cap empty rows at 35% of the final training set; if already below cap, keep all empty rows.
trainingDecision.mediumTreatment: When the resolved gate is used, HIGH and MEDIUM rows receive identical standard BCE treatment; no invented gold weights. Consensus status remains recorded for analysis.
trainingDecision.failure: DO_NOT_TRAIN; do not relax gates, add an adjudicator, regenerate for label quotas, or inspect RTN rows

candidateTrainingIfFeasible.updates: Product-18 classifier head plus top two encoder layers only
candidateTrainingIfFeasible.checkpointSelection: single final checkpoint; no interim COSO or RTN evaluation and no sweep

evaluation.selector: unchanged Product-18 global threshold 0.35, probability-descending fixed-order tie-break, maximum two labels
evaluation.RTN300: one frozen candidate-vs-incumbent comparison on HIGH_CONSENSUS and RESOLVED reference subsets after candidate is completely trained

successCriteria.RTNResolved: micro-F1>=0.3313265306; macro-F1>=0.3134; exact-set>=50.41%; precision>=0.3342; recall>=0.2857; FP<=64; FN<=85; summed absolute 0/1/2 count error<=54
successCriteria.COSO149: micro-F1>=0.5230528053; macro-F1>=0.3401786297; exact-set no more than 1 point below incumbent; FP<=60; FN<=87; no support>=5 label loses >0.05 F1
successCriteria.broadImprovement: all gates must pass and at least two RTN-resolved per-label F1 values with reference support>=5 improve by >=0.02 while none regress by >0.10
successCriteria.decision: RETAIN_FOR_RESEARCH only if every gate passes; otherwise REJECT, or INCONCLUSIVE if the frozen evaluation cannot establish direction

forbidden: RTN/COSO/incumbent use in product audit, sample selection, weak labels, class weights, quotas, loss, LR, epochs, threshold, or checkpoint selection
hyperparameter, label quota, consensus threshold, loss, selector, or seed sweep
